# telnyx_pay_connectors (Data Source)

Lists pay connectors, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_pay_connector`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_created_at_eq` (String)
- `filter_created_at_gt` (String)
- `filter_created_at_gte` (String)
- `filter_created_at_lt` (String)
- `filter_created_at_lte` (String)
- `filter_mode` (String)
- `filter_name` (String)
- `filter_type` (String)
- `filter_updated_at_eq` (String)
- `filter_updated_at_gt` (String)
- `filter_updated_at_gte` (String)
- `filter_updated_at_lt` (String)
- `filter_updated_at_lte` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String)

### Read-Only

- `pay_connectors` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pay_connectors))

<a id="nestedatt--pay_connectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pay_connectors`

Read-Only:

- `config` (Attributes) Redacted stored configuration. Generic connector fields are shown here. Unknown config keys are discarded. Password and token are never returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pay_connectors--config))
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Connector identifier.
- `mode` (String) Configured mode.
- `name` (String) Connector name used for retrieval, update, deletion and Pay.
- `organization_id` (String) Owning organization; assigned from authentication, not request input.
- `record_type` (String) Resource type.
- `type` (String) Connector type; generic is covered by this reference. Other types may appear in unfiltered lists.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time.
- `user_id` (String) Creating user; assigned from authentication, not request input.

<a id="nestedatt--pay_connectors--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pay_connectors.config`

Read-Only:

- `auth_type` (String) Stored processor authentication selection. Omitted if it was not explicitly configured.
- `endpoint_url` (String) HTTP or HTTPS processor URL with a host. Use HTTPS to protect payment data in transit.
- `timeout` (Number) Stored processor HTTP timeout in milliseconds. Omitted when no timeout was configured; the effective runtime default is 10000.
- `username` (String) Stored username, when supplied. Required to be a nonblank string for basic authentication.
